newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Oct wage inflation 3.7 pct-ISTAT.
newsitem.headline: Italian Oct wage inflation 3.7 pct-ISTAT.

text.p: Italian wage inflation stood at an annual 3.7 percent in October, statistics institute ISTAT said in a statement.
ISTAT said it had calculated the figures using a new base year of 1995.

Istat said wage inflation in the agriculture sector 0.8 percent year-on-year in October, 3.2 percent in the industrial sector, 7.2 percent in the chemical sector, 2.6 percent in the metal workers sector, 3.4 percent in the service sector and 1.5 percent in the transport and communications sector.
The statistics office added that the number of hours lost to industrial action in the the first nine months of 1996 was a provisional 4.4 million hours, down 5.2 percent on the same 1995 period.
